title: The Twilight Zone Radio Dramas
paragraphs: Full-cast audio adaptations that revisit stories associated with The Twilight Zone for radio, using a recurring host and new performers while preserving the series' science-fiction, fantasy, and moral-twist storytelling.

Licensed full-cast audio anthology hosted/narrated by Stacy Keach. GRH contains the complete 176-title radio release set: 155 titles correspond to episodes/presentations in the 1959-64 television run and 21 are special/non-TV radio entries including unrealized scripts, precursor material and original radio stories.
GRH documents the program through Falcon syndicated radio-drama era (2002 to 2012).

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Stacy Keach (narrator on 176 recordings and performer on 4 recordings), Dennis Etchison (radio adaptor on 157 recordings and writer on 2 recordings), Mike Starr (performer on 10 recordings), Stan Freberg (performer on 7 recordings), Blair Underwood (performer on 6 recordings), Chelcie Ross (performer on 6 recordings), and Tim Kazurinsky (performer on 6 recordings).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include identity and unstable reality, time, memory and alternate reality, technology and dehumanization, mortality, aging and death, conformity, prejudice and social pressure, and isolation and alienation.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Classic television stories remade for modern radio, Celebrity-led syndicated audio drama revival, and Unproduced Twilight Zone scripts realized in audio.
